name: E-com Model Studio
description: One clothing photo in, a full e-commerce set out: a model card plus four studio shots — front three-quarter, turned away, back, detail — of the same model in the same clothing on white.
markdownDescription:
## E-com Model Studio

One clothing photo becomes a full e-commerce set on a model. No photoshoot, no separate model build.

1. **Clothing photo** — a packshot or flat lay on a plain background. The one thing that never changes.
2. **Model + Styling notes** — pick the look from tiles; say how the clothing is worn and what goes with it.
3. **Clothing notes** — an AI reads the photo once and writes the clothing down precisely, so every shot agrees on the details.
4. **Model card** — one full-body photo of the model in the clothing. Every shot uses it as its reference.
5. **Four shots** — front three-quarter, turned away, back, detail. Same model, same clothing, same white studio.

data.text: Worn open over a plain white ribbed tank top, with straight-leg ecru trousers and clean white leather sneakers. Sleeves pushed up once. Hair down. No jewellery.
data.label: Styling notes
Clothing notes
data.userInput: Describe the clothing in the reference image.
data.systemPrompt: You write clothing descriptions for an image generator. Look at the reference image and describe the clothing in ONE paragraph of 50–70 words, plain declarative English: clothing type, colour, fabric and finish, collar, closure, pockets, cuffs, fit and drape. Only what is visible. No brand names, no opinions, no bullet points, no commentary. Output only the paragraph.

data.label: Model card
data.prompt: E-commerce studio photograph, full body head to toe, of {Model || a fashion model} standing relaxed and facing the camera on a pure white seamless studio background. The model wears the exact clothing from the clothing reference image, unchanged: {Clothing notes || the clothing in the clothing reference image.} Worn as follows: {Styling notes || as it comes.} {Lighting || soft diffused studio light}, a soft shadow under the shoes, natural skin, calm expression, no props, no text. Sharp and clean.

data.label: Shot 1 · Front three-quarter
data.prompt: The same model and the same outfit as in the model card reference image — identical face, hair, skin and clothing. The clothing exactly as in the clothing reference image: {Clothing notes || the clothing in the clothing reference image.} Three-quarter front view, cropped from mid-thigh up, body angled slightly to the camera, looking straight into the lens with a calm confident expression, one hand in a trouser pocket, the other relaxed at the side. Pure white seamless studio background, {Lighting || soft diffused studio light}, a gentle shadow at the feet. Clean e-commerce photography, sharp, natural, no props, no text.

data.label: Shot 2 · Turned away
data.prompt: The same model and the same outfit as in the model card reference image — identical face, hair, skin and clothing. The clothing exactly as in the clothing reference image: {Clothing notes || the clothing in the clothing reference image.} Body turned three-quarters away from the camera, face looking back over the shoulder into the lens, arms relaxed at the sides, hair swept to the camera side so the side and back of the clothing stay visible, cropped from mid-thigh up. Pure white seamless studio background, {Lighting || soft diffused studio light}, a gentle shadow at the feet. Clean e-commerce photography, sharp, natural, no props, no text.

data.label: Shot 3 · Back
data.prompt: The same model and the same outfit as in the model card reference image — identical face, hair, skin and clothing. The clothing exactly as in the clothing reference image: {Clothing notes || the clothing in the clothing reference image.} Standing with the back fully to the camera, a slight hip shift for ease, hair over one shoulder so the whole back of the clothing is visible — yoke, collar and hem clear — cropped from mid-thigh up. Pure white seamless studio background, {Lighting || soft diffused studio light}, a gentle shadow at the feet. Clean e-commerce photography, sharp, natural, no props, no text.

data.label: Shot 4 · Detail
data.prompt: The same model and the same outfit as in the model card reference image — identical face, hair, skin and clothing. The clothing exactly as in the clothing reference image: {Clothing notes || the clothing in the clothing reference image.} A close-up of the chest and torso from just below the collar to the waist, no face in frame, body at a slight angle for depth, one hand resting lightly on the opposite forearm; focus on the collar, the placket, the pocket flaps, the fabric texture and one cuff. Pure white seamless studio background, {Lighting || soft diffused studio light}, a gentle shadow at the feet. Clean e-commerce photography, sharp, natural, no props, no text.
